title: TestSprite submits a property listing request
description: A visitor can complete the property listing request form and see a bilingual success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /request
Select the property listing tab
Fill in the name field with TestSprite Listing Lead
Fill in the contact field with TestSprite Listing Contact
Fill in the property type field with a suitable property type
Fill in the location field with a suitable location
Fill in the budget field with a suitable budget
Submit the form
Verify a bilingual success confirmation is visible

title: TestSprite owner inquiry form can be revealed and submitted with images
description: Verifies that a property owner can reveal the legacy listing form, add valid images, submit it, and see a confirmation state.

steps.description: Navigate to /list-property
Scroll to the start section for property owners
Reveal the inquiry form
Fill in a valid name in the listing form
Fill in a valid phone number in the listing form
Fill in a valid email in the listing form
Fill in valid property details in the listing form
Upload one or more valid property images
Submit the listing form
Verify a confirmation state is visible
Verify the listing request was submitted successfully

title: TestSprite submits Property Match from /find-property

steps.description: Navigate to /find-property

Fill in the name field with TestSprite Property Match Lead
Fill in the phone field with 0812345678
Fill in the email field with testsprite.match@example.com

Fill in the location field with Ban Bueng, Chonburi
Fill in the budget field with 2,500,000 THB

title: TestSprite shows validation for an incomplete email field

Submit the form
